title: Anima vs. Accurx: patient triage, communication and AI scribes
summary: Anima vs. Accurx for NHS GP practices: compare patient triage, messaging, booking and AI medical scribes, with feature tables and practical FAQs.
body_markdown:
## What is patient communication and triage software?


Patient communication and triage software helps GP practices understand what patients need, decide how to respond and organise the resulting work. Online consultation forms, telephone requests and reception conversations should give staff enough information to direct each request to an appropriate service or member of the team. Patients need a clear route to care. Your team needs the information to respond, a way to share the work and a clear view of what remains to be done.


Anima, Accurx, eConsult and Patchs help practices gather and manage patient requests. The work continues after the form is submitted: your team needs to review the information, respond and arrange care. Here’s how Anima and Accurx support that journey.


## Comparing Anima and Accurx


For practices considering an Accurx alternative, compare the full journey from a patient request to its resolution. Accurx offers patient messaging, Patient Triage and Reception Flow, alongside booking and other tools. Its current primary-care page also describes AI-assisted information gathering. The tables below compare triage and communication first, then Anima Scribe and Accurx Scribe as a separate workflow.

## FAQs


### What should you check when comparing online consultation and total triage systems?


Try a clinical request, an administrative query and a request entered by reception on a patient's behalf. Check how staff find the information they need, allocate work, ask follow-up questions and book an appointment. Review how the system handles patients who cannot use an online form. A shared inbox is useful only if the team can see what needs doing and who is responsible.


### What should you check about SMS messaging and appointment booking?


Compare individual messages, batch messaging, questionnaires and patient replies separately. For appointment booking, ask which slot types patients can select, how booking rules are controlled and what is recorded in the clinical system. Request a demonstration using the EMIS Web or SystmOne configuration your practice uses.


### What should you check when comparing Anima Scribe and Accurx Scribe?


Try the same consultation scenario in each tool and compare the draft notes with what was said. Check corrections, code suggestions and the complete save-to-record process. Confirm which recording methods and templates are included in the proposed plan. A clinician should review the output before saving it.


### How should a practice compare costs?


Ask for a quote that lists the required modules, messaging charges, implementation, training and ongoing support. Compare the cost of your existing patient communication and online consultation tools with the proposed setup. Include the time needed to manage requests and duplicate information, without assuming that one supplier's standard package includes every feature.


## Are you planning a change in patient communication and triage?
